本文收录同一个任务内多个 Agent 或子 Agent 如何传递证据、交付产物和.zh: 本文收录同一个任务内多个 Agent 或子 Agent 如何传递证据、交付产物和协调执行，以及推理服务如何处理这些协作产生的请求。独立会话共享服务、多候选独立采样和同一任务内的协作分别记载。
本文收录同一个任务内多个 Agent 或子 Agent 如何传递证据、交付产物和.en: This paper records how multiple Agents or sub-Agents within the same task pass evidence, deliver artifacts, and coordinate execution, as well as how reasoning services handle requests generated by this collaboration. It separately documents independent session-shared services, multiple independent candidate sampling, and collaboration within the same task.

指 Agent 传递结论、约束、接口约定或原始证据，接收者可以据此改变自己的行动.zh: 指 Agent 传递结论、约束、接口约定或原始证据，接收者可以据此改变自己的行动。
指 Agent 传递结论、约束、接口约定或原始证据，接收者可以据此改变自己的行动.en: Refers to Agents passing conclusions, constraints, interface conventions, or raw evidence, which the recipient can use to change their own actions.

指 Agent 通过代码补丁、文件、测试日志或可检索记录交接工作。制品存在和另一.zh: 指 Agent 通过代码补丁、文件、测试日志或可检索记录交接工作。制品存在和另一位 Agent 已读取它是两个事件。
指 Agent 通过代码补丁、文件、测试日志或可检索记录交接工作。制品存在和另一.en: Refers to Agents handing over work via code patches, files, test logs, or retrievable records. The existence of an artifact and another Agent having read it are two separate events.

指引擎利用已处理的 token 前缀等状态省下重复计算。相同文本能否复用 KV.zh: 指引擎利用已处理的 token 前缀等状态省下重复计算。相同文本能否复用 KV 还取决于模型、前缀位置、token 化和缓存驻留。
指引擎利用已处理的 token 前缀等状态省下重复计算。相同文本能否复用 KV.en: Refers to engines saving repeated computation by using states such as processed token prefixes. Whether the same text can reuse KV also depends on the model, prefix position, tokenization, and cache residency.

指后续工作所需的产物已经可用。任务可以并发启动，但其中某些操作仍然需要等待前序.zh: 指后续工作所需的产物已经可用。任务可以并发启动，但其中某些操作仍然需要等待前序 Agent 交付。
指后续工作所需的产物已经可用。任务可以并发启动，但其中某些操作仍然需要等待前序.en: Refers to artifacts needed for subsequent work being available. Tasks can start concurrently, but some operations still need to wait for delivery from preceding Agents.

一个子 Agent 完成自己的代码后，另一个子 Agent 仍可能按旧接口开发。.zh: 一个子 Agent 完成自己的代码后，另一个子 Agent 仍可能按旧接口开发。仅看汇总测试通过率，很难定位哪一条交接出了问题。AsynCodeBench 把代码任务拆成具有实际依赖的实现单元，用显式有向图和可执行检查器记录上下游是否接通。数据来自 16 个公开仓库的 19 个任务，含 52 条人工核验的有向依赖。
一个子 Agent 完成自己的代码后，另一个子 Agent 仍可能按旧接口开发。.en: After one sub-agent completes its code, another sub-agent may still develop according to the old interface. Looking only at the overall test pass rate makes it difficult to locate which handoff went wrong. AsynCodeBench splits code tasks into implementation units with actual dependencies, using explicit directed graphs and executable checkers to record whether upstream and downstream are connected. The data comes from 19 tasks in 16 public repositories, containing 52 manually verified directed dependencies.

例如上游实现新接口，下游调用这个接口。局部检查记录各自工作区的状态，集成检查记录.zh: 例如上游实现新接口，下游调用这个接口。局部检查记录各自工作区的状态，集成检查记录合并后依赖是否满足。
例如上游实现新接口，下游调用这个接口。局部检查记录各自工作区的状态，集成检查记录.en: For example, the upstream implements a new interface, and the downstream calls this interface. Local checks record the state of each workspace, and integration checks record whether dependencies are satisfied after merging.

单 Agent 完整执行，串行分工与交接，私有工作区异步分工，以及异步分工加只读.zh: 单 Agent 完整执行，串行分工与交接，私有工作区异步分工，以及异步分工加只读管理者或允许有限修复的管理者。各协议共享任务包、OpenHands harness 和任务专用 Docker 环境。
单 Agent 完整执行，串行分工与交接，私有工作区异步分工，以及异步分工加只读.en: Single-agent full execution, serial division of labor and handoff, asynchronous division of labor in private workspaces, and asynchronous division of labor with either read-only managers or managers allowing limited fixes. All protocols share task packages, OpenHands harness, and task-specific Docker environments.

ADPR 是最终满足的依赖比例。DRS 是一条依赖首次通过检查的逻辑位置。它使用.zh: ADPR 是最终满足的依赖比例。DRS 是一条依赖首次通过检查的逻辑位置。它使用集成检查点，单 Agent 只有最终工作区，因此只参与最终依赖评估。
ADPR 是最终满足的依赖比例。DRS 是一条依赖首次通过检查的逻辑位置。它使用.en: ADPR is the proportion of dependencies ultimately satisfied. DRS is the logical position where a dependency first passes the check. It uses integration checkpoints; a single agent only has the final workspace and thus only participates in the final dependency evaluation.

整体测试通过率较高时，跨组件依赖仍可能大量未解决。更强的单 Agent 编码能力.zh: 整体测试通过率较高时，跨组件依赖仍可能大量未解决。更强的单 Agent 编码能力也未必在所有协作协议中转化成更好的依赖闭合。作者以任务平均 token 开销衡量成本，分别用测试通过率和 ADPR 画质量—成本曲线，部分模型的优选协议随质量指标变化。论文未用 DRS 表示真实秒数。
整体测试通过率较高时，跨组件依赖仍可能大量未解决。更强的单 Agent 编码能力.en: Even when overall test pass rates are high, cross-component dependencies may still remain largely unresolved. Stronger single-agent coding ability does not necessarily translate to better dependency closure in all collaboration protocols. The authors measure cost by the average token consumption per task, and plot quality–cost curves using test pass rates and ADPR, with some models' preferred protocols changing depending on the quality metric. The paper does not use DRS to represent actual seconds.

实验覆盖十个开放权重模型，包括.zh: 实验覆盖十个开放权重模型，包括
实验覆盖十个开放权重模型，包括.en: The experiments cover ten open-weight models, including

的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash。完整模型列表见附录 D。任务元数据、检查.zh: 的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash。完整模型列表见附录 D。任务元数据、检查器与复现入口见仓库，主文的推理引擎版本未核实。
的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash。完整模型列表见附录 D。任务元数据、检查.en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash. The complete list of models can be found in Appendix D. Task metadata, checkers, and reproduction entry points are available in the repository, and the reasoning engine version in the main text has not been verified.

两个开发者分别委托 Agent 改同一个仓库。每个 Agent 初始只知道自己的.zh: 两个开发者分别委托 Agent 改同一个仓库。每个 Agent 初始只知道自己的需求，因此即使两份补丁分别通过测试，集成后也可能因接口假设不一致而失败。ParallACT 从 SWE-Bench Pro 的需求和 Docker 镜像出发，加入独立的第二条需求、参考补丁和验收测试，得到 155 对任务。互补型任务要求接口对接，冲突型任务需要协调同一段代码上的两种修改，两个需求最终可以同时满足。
两个开发者分别委托 Agent 改同一个仓库。每个 Agent 初始只知道自己的.en: Two developers separately commissioned Agents to modify the same repository. Each Agent initially only knows its own requirements, so even if both patches pass testing individually, their integration may fail due to inconsistent interface assumptions. ParallACT starts from the requirements and Docker images of SWE-Bench Pro, adds an independent second set of requirements, reference patches, and acceptance tests, resulting in 155 pairs of tasks. Complementary tasks require interface coordination, while conflicting tasks require reconciling two modifications on the same piece of code, allowing both requirements to ultimately be satisfied simultaneously.

实验比较掌握两条需求的单 Agent、串行交接、私有工作区并行，以及让并行 Ag.zh: 实验比较掌握两条需求的单 Agent、串行交接、私有工作区并行，以及让并行 Agent 使用共享文件或 Redis 传消息或同步。按合并后的联合验收和相对加权 token 成本评分。并行评测允许多种合并方式，有一种通过即记成功。开放权重模型在 Claude Code 或 Codex harness 中运行，由 vLLM 服务，使用 Qwen3.8 Flash Next、DeepSeek V4 Flash 和 GLM 5.3 Flash。闭源对照使用 Claude Code 与 Claude Opus 4.8。
实验比较掌握两条需求的单 Agent、串行交接、私有工作区并行，以及让并行 Ag.en: The experiment compares mastering two requirements with a single agent, serial handoff, private workspace parallelism, and letting parallel agents use shared files or Redis to send messages or synchronize. Evaluation is based on the merged joint acceptance and relative weighted token cost. Parallel evaluation allows multiple merging methods, with one method succeeding immediately. Open-weight models run in the Claude Code or Codex harness, served by vLLM, using Qwen 3.8 Flash Next, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and GLM 5.3 Flash. Closed-source comparison uses Claude Code and Claude Opus 4.8.

加入通信可以部分挽回并行执行的联合通过率，也增加 token 开销。作者观察到消.zh: 加入通信可以部分挽回并行执行的联合通过率，也增加 token 开销。作者观察到消息内容常与任务有关，但可能读得太晚，已经同意的设计也可能未落实。Redis 同步与共享文件同步的通过率差异未达到显著水平。实验覆盖两个 Agent，成本以各配置自己的单 Agent 全知对照为参照。
加入通信可以部分挽回并行执行的联合通过率，也增加 token 开销。作者观察到消.en: Adding communication can partially recover the joint success rate of parallel execution, but also increases token overhead. The authors observed that the message content is often related to the task, but it may be read too late, and the agreed-upon design may not have been implemented. The difference in success rates between Redis synchronization and shared file synchronization was not significant. The experiment involved two Agents, and the cost was measured relative to each configuring its own single-Agent omniscient baseline.

具身协作任务里，相邻高层计划常反复出现，例如抓取后运输。每个 Agent 记录前.zh: 具身协作任务里，相邻高层计划常反复出现，例如抓取后运输。每个 Agent 记录前一计划到后一计划的转移和适用状态范围，先用当前状态过滤候选，再结合历史次数与后台确认记录打分。命中后可立即行动，后台 LLM 根据发起时的上下文检查已执行轨迹。反馈到达后，系统强化确认的转移，或在新计划可执行时进行校正。缓存未命中时等待 LLM 规划。
具身协作任务里，相邻高层计划常反复出现，例如抓取后运输。每个 Agent 记录前.en: In embodied collaboration tasks, adjacent high-level plans often repeat, such as grasping then transporting. Each agent records the transition from the previous plan to the next and the applicable state range, first filtering candidates using the current state, then scoring them based on historical frequency and backend confirmation records. Once matched, action can be taken immediately, while the backend LLM checks the executed trajectory against the context at initiation. Once feedback arrives, the system reinforces confirmed transitions or corrects them when a new plan becomes executable. If there is a cache miss, it waits for the LLM to plan.

有重复计划结构的任务可以减少逐步等待模型。后台校正有延迟，错过交接或争抢资源时，.zh: 有重复计划结构的任务可以减少逐步等待模型。后台校正有延迟，错过交接或争抢资源时，已经发生的环境变化仍需处理。评测使用 TDW-MAT、TDW-COOK、TDW-GAME 和 BEHAVIOR-1K 模拟或图环境，接入 CoELA、COMBO、COHERENT，调用 GPT-5、GPT-5-mini、GPT-5-nano 的 API。主结果包含轨迹预填充，另有空缓存对照。论文记录成功率、执行耗时、token 与费用。
有重复计划结构的任务可以减少逐步等待模型。后台校正有延迟，错过交接或争抢资源时，.en: Tasks with repetitive plan structures can reduce step-by-step waiting for the model. Backend correction has latency; when handoff is missed or resources are contested, environmental changes that have already occurred still need to be handled. Evaluations use simulated or visual environments such as TDW-MAT, TDW-COOK, TDW-GAME, and BEHAVIOR-1K, integrating CoELA, COMBO, and COHERENT, calling APIs of GPT-5, GPT-5-mini, and GPT-5-nano. Main results include trajectory pre-filling, along with empty-cache comparisons. The paper records success rate, execution time, tokens, and cost.

多个编码 Agent 并行工作时，普通消息需要接收者自行记住何时使用某条发现，也.zh: 多个编码 Agent 并行工作时，普通消息需要接收者自行记住何时使用某条发现，也需要上下游自行检查约定有没有落实。AECP 让一个负责人划分模块，再用两类结构化产物协调并行 worker。
多个编码 Agent 并行工作时，普通消息需要接收者自行记住何时使用某条发现，也.en: When multiple coding Agents work in parallel, ordinary messages require receivers to remember when to use a finding, and upstream and downstream must also check whether agreements were implemented. AECP has a lead divide modules, then uses two types of structured artifacts to coordinate parallel workers.

Worker 提交发现、适用的函数或文件，以及可选的可执行证据。Harness.zh: Worker 提交发现、适用的函数或文件，以及可选的可执行证据。Harness 在其他 worker 读取相关代码时把发现随工具结果交付。证据检查失败的发现可以撤回。
Worker 提交发现、适用的函数或文件，以及可选的可执行证据。Harness.en: Workers submit discoveries, applicable functions or files, and optionally executable evidence. The harness delivers discoveries along with tool results when other workers read the related code. Discoveries whose evidence check fails can be withdrawn.

上游声明公开符号和签名。Harness 据此生成可导入的接口桩，让下游能先开发。.zh: 上游声明公开符号和签名。Harness 据此生成可导入的接口桩，让下游能先开发。上游提交实现时，harness 检查可静态判断的接口偏差。若契约改版，使用旧约定的下游需要重新检查自己的实现。
上游声明公开符号和签名。Harness 据此生成可导入的接口桩，让下游能先开发。.en: The upstream declares public symbols and signatures. Harness generates importable interface stubs based on this, allowing downstream development to start first. When the upstream submits implementations, the harness checks for statically determinable interface deviations. If the contract is revised, downstreams using the old agreement need to recheck their implementations.

在 Doc2Repo、NL2Repo 和 CodeProjectEval 的从规.zh: 在 Doc2Repo、NL2Repo 和 CodeProjectEval 的从规格生成仓库任务中，作者报告 AECP 相比两种团队基线提高隐藏测试通过率、缩短墙钟时间。相比单 Agent，它平均使用更多输出 token。与集成者基线的第一步消融同时引入共享工作区和知识产物，因此该对比无法单独归因于知识投递。主实验使用 AWS Strands Agents SDK，另用 mini-SWE-agent 做一组复核。Claude Opus 4.8、Opus 4.6 与 Sonnet 5 通过 Bedrock 调用，DeepSeek-V4-Flash 与 GLM-5.2 通过 OpenRouter 调用。底层引擎和硬件未披露。
在 Doc2Repo、NL2Repo 和 CodeProjectEval 的从规.en: In repository generation from specifications on Doc2Repo, NL2Repo, and CodeProjectEval, the authors report that AECP improves hidden-test pass rates and shortens wall-clock time compared with two team baselines. Compared with a single Agent, it uses more output tokens on average. The first-step ablation against the integrator baseline introduces both a shared workspace and knowledge artifacts, so the comparison cannot be attributed to knowledge delivery alone. The main experiment uses the AWS Strands Agents SDK, with a separate verification run using mini-SWE-agent. Claude Opus 4.8, Opus 4.6, and Sonnet 5 are called through Bedrock, while DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GLM-5.2 are called through OpenRouter. The underlying engine and hardware are not disclosed.

常规请求接口看到的是各自完整的 prompt，应用内部“谁产生这段内容、谁接下来.zh: 常规请求接口看到的是各自完整的 prompt，应用内部“谁产生这段内容、谁接下来消费”的关系容易丢失。Parrot 用
常规请求接口看到的是各自完整的 prompt，应用内部“谁产生这段内容、谁接下来.en: Regular request interfaces see the full prompt individually, making the internal "who generates this content and who consumes it next" relationship easily lost. Parrot uses

显式标记 prompt 里的输入和输出槽位。变量的值可以是自然语言或代码，生产者.zh: 显式标记 prompt 里的输入和输出槽位。变量的值可以是自然语言或代码，生产者与消费者通过同一变量建立依赖。
显式标记 prompt 里的输入和输出槽位。变量的值可以是自然语言或代码，生产者.en: to explicitly mark input and output slots in the prompt. The value of a variable can be natural language or code, and producers and consumers establish dependencies through the same variable.

把变量接入请求图。.en: Integrate variables into the request graph.

编排器提交带变量引用的请求。服务端按引用增量建立数据依赖图，能够识别前序输出、依.zh: 编排器提交带变量引用的请求。服务端按引用增量建立数据依赖图，能够识别前序输出、依赖它的请求以及可并行的请求组。
编排器提交带变量引用的请求。服务端按引用增量建立数据依赖图，能够识别前序输出、依.en: The orchestrator submits requests with variable references. The server incrementally builds a data dependency graph based on the references, capable of identifying previous outputs, requests that depend on them, and groups of requests that can be executed in parallel.

将应用目标传到请求调度。.zh: 将应用目标传到请求调度。
将应用目标传到请求调度。.en: Pass the application goals to request scheduling.

以最终输出为观察点分析依赖，把应用完成时间或吞吐目标落实到请求的调度与 batc.zh: 以最终输出为观察点分析依赖，把应用完成时间或吞吐目标落实到请求的调度与 batching。
以最终输出为观察点分析依赖，把应用完成时间或吞吐目标落实到请求的调度与 batc.en: Analyze dependencies with the final output as the observation point, and implement application completion time or throughput targets into request scheduling and batching.

多个消费者若把同一段动态产生的语义变量安排成共同前缀，系统可以共享对应 KV。P.zh: 多个消费者若把同一段动态产生的语义变量安排成共同前缀，系统可以共享对应 KV。Parrot 也实现了面向共享前缀的 attention 计算路径。
多个消费者若把同一段动态产生的语义变量安排成共同前缀，系统可以共享对应 KV。P.en: If multiple consumers arrange the same dynamically generated semantic variable as a common prefix, the system can share the corresponding KV. Parrot also implements an attention computation path for shared prefixes.

例如架构师生成项目目录和接口说明。多个编码 Agent 都需要它，但各自负责不同.zh: 例如架构师生成项目目录和接口说明。多个编码 Agent 都需要它，但各自负责不同文件。语义变量把这段共享产物及其消费者显式告诉服务端，让消费者并行、共享共同前缀，也让最后的集成请求知道要等哪些文件。
例如架构师生成项目目录和接口说明。多个编码 Agent 都需要它，但各自负责不同.en: For example, an architect generates a project directory and interface specifications. Multiple coding agents need it, but each is responsible for different files. Semantic variables explicitly communicate this shared artifact and its consumers to the server, allowing consumers to work in parallel, share the common prefix, and also let the final integration request know which files to wait for.

论文 §8.4 在一张 A100 上用 LLaMA 13B 运行 MetaGPT.zh: 论文 §8.4 在一张 A100 上用 LLaMA 13B 运行 MetaGPT 式的架构师、编码者、审查者工作流，观察到端到端时间与 KV 内存改善。共享前缀、调度批次和专门 attention 实现都贡献了收益。实测比较采用论文当时的 FastChat／vLLM 等基线，主要回答服务效率问题。该组结果没有用现代仓库修复闭环来验证代码正确率。代码公开为 ParrotServe，较大系统实验还包含其他应用与 LLaMA 7B。
论文 §8.4 在一张 A100 上用 LLaMA 13B 运行 MetaGPT.en: Section 8.4 of the paper runs a MetaGPT-style architect, coder, and reviewer workflow with LLaMA 13B on an A100, observing improvements in end-to-end time and KV memory. Shared prefixes, scheduled batches, and dedicated attention implementations all contribute. The measurements compare against baselines such as FastChat/vLLM from the time of the paper and mainly address serving efficiency. This set of results does not verify code correctness with a modern repository closed-loop fix. The code is public as ParrotServe, and larger system experiments also include other applications and LLaMA 7B.

一个工作流经常沿相似的角色顺序执行。CacheScout 在线统计 Agent.zh: 一个工作流经常沿相似的角色顺序执行。CacheScout 在线统计 Agent 调用转移，估计哪些角色很快会被调用，把这个信号用于固定角色前缀的驱逐与提前准备。固定前缀包括系统提示、工具说明和示例。
一个工作流经常沿相似的角色顺序执行。CacheScout 在线统计 Agent.en: A workflow often executes along a similar sequence of roles. CacheScout online tracks agent call transitions to estimate which roles are likely to be invoked soon, using this signal for eviction and preloading of fixed role prefixes. Fixed prefixes include system prompts, tool specifications, and examples.

角色执行顺序能为缓存调度提供复用信号，提前准备也需要与前台请求竞争资源。论文关注.zh: 角色执行顺序能为缓存调度提供复用信号，提前准备也需要与前台请求竞争资源。论文关注固定前缀服务效率。问答、对话、搜索和编码场景的实验主要比较 TTFT、每轮延迟、吞吐和缓存命中。harness 与引擎的具体版本暂列未核实。
角色执行顺序能为缓存调度提供复用信号，提前准备也需要与前台请求竞争资源。论文关注.en: The execution order of roles can provide reuse signals for cache scheduling, and prefetching must also compete with foreground requests for resources. The paper focuses on fixed-prefix serving efficiency. Experiments in Q&A, dialogue, search, and coding scenarios mainly compare TTFT, per-turn latency, throughput, and cache hits. The exact harness and engine versions remain unverified.

并行 worker 节省的执行时间，需要覆盖重新探索上下文和最终对齐产物的开销。.zh: 并行 worker 节省的执行时间，需要覆盖重新探索上下文和最终对齐产物的开销。SquidAgent 在规划时同时生成子任务依赖图、各任务预计输出 token 数和每层预计协调 token 数。依赖图按拓扑层分组，同层任务满足依赖后可以并行。
并行 worker 节省的执行时间，需要覆盖重新探索上下文和最终对齐产物的开销。.en: The execution time saved by parallel workers needs to cover the overhead of re-exploring context and final alignment artifacts. SquidAgent generates the subtask dependency graph, estimated output tokens for each task, and estimated coordination tokens per layer during planning. Dependency graphs are grouped by topological layers, and tasks within the same layer can run in parallel once dependencies are satisfied.

Worker 从负责人的会话分叉，获得已有架构决策、约束和计划，减少重新理解任务.zh: Worker 从负责人的会话分叉，获得已有架构决策、约束和计划，减少重新理解任务。当前仓库的 worktree 模式使用会话分叉与独立分支，agent-tool 模式向子 Agent 交付计划和约定。
Worker 从负责人的会话分叉，获得已有架构决策、约束和计划，减少重新理解任务.en: Workers branch from the leader's session, obtaining existing architectural decisions, constraints, and plans, reducing the need to re-understand the task. The current repository's worktree mode uses session branching and independent branches, while the agent-tool mode delivers plans and agreements to sub-Agents.

启动并行层前，负责人写出命名、接口、格式及跨文件引用规则，降低产物完成后的对齐开.en: Before starting the parallel layer, the leader specifies naming, interfaces, formats, and cross-file reference rules to reduce alignment overhead after the results are completed.

在九个自建编码、技术写作和规划任务上，作者报告相较 Claude Code 的平.zh: 在九个自建编码、技术写作和规划任务上，作者报告相较 Claude Code 的平均墙钟加速约为 2.6 倍，交付词数／秒提高约为 2.2 倍。该吞吐定义同时受产物长度和完成时间影响，质量另由 Claude Opus 4.6 对任务条目评分。实验执行模型为 Claude Sonnet 4.6。生成长度对模型生成主导的任务有预测价值，工具执行、外部 API 和服务排队还需要单独计时。当前评测以自建产物任务为主。
在九个自建编码、技术写作和规划任务上，作者报告相较 Claude Code 的平.en: On nine in-house coding, technical writing, and planning tasks, the authors report an average wall-clock speedup of about 2.6x over Claude Code, with delivered words per second increasing by about 2.2x. This throughput definition depends on both artifact length and completion time, while quality is rated separately by Claude Opus 4.6 for each task entry. The execution model is Claude Sonnet 4.6. Generation length is predictive for model-generation-dominated tasks, while tool execution, external API calls, and service queuing still require separate timing. The current evaluation focuses mainly on in-house artifact tasks.

The underlying inference engine and server hardware are not disclosed. The paper's prompts and task descriptions are public, and no new model training was required.

协作设置记录一个任务内有几个角色、怎样交接。共享对象区分消息、代码制品、计划与模.en: The collaboration setup records how many roles a task has and how they hand off. Shared objects distinguish messages, code artifacts, plans, and model computation state. Benchmarks determine the task and acceptance criteria; the harness controls workspaces, tools, and messages; the engine executes model inference. DRS is logical progress, while TTFT is request latency; the two are recorded separately.
